title: [SW-55978] [SW-55979] (HO) (Feature) Default Hiscox upgrade years to 1985 with a Systems Update Attestation

comments.author: copilot-pull-request-reviewer
comments.body: `IsSystemsAttestationConfig` is called from `IsConfigSupported` on every risk evaluation and also from the quote-element adjustment path. Passing these four boundaries as inline `params` creates a new array on every call, contrary to the established version-gating pattern in `Swyfft.Services/RiskSelection/AGENTS.md:213-245`. Store the boundaries in a `private static readonly HomeownerStateConfig[]` field and pass that field instead.
